chunks: The first thing for which the servant will be held accountable is salat (prayer). If it is accepted, the rest of his deeds will be accepted from him; and if it is rejected against him, the rest of his deeds will be rejected against him.

key_terms.أَوَّلُ: the first; indicating priority in reckoning
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: the servant; the human being before Allah
key_terms.سَائِرُ عَمَلِهِ: the rest of his deeds; all his other actions
key_terms.يُحَاسَبُ: will be called to account; will be judged

ai.seo_question: What is the first deed a servant will be judged for, and how does it affect all other deeds?
ai.summary: This hadith states that salat (prayer) is the first deed for which the servant is called to account. Its acceptance or rejection affects the acceptance or rejection of the rest of a person's deeds, showing its central place in a believer's life.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.626 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The first thing a servant will be held accountable for is prayer. If it is accepted, the rest of his deeds will be accepted; and if it is rejected, the rest of his deeds will be rejected."
